artifacts.notes: Complete Latin textual body as delivered, dedicatory preface and chapters I–XIV, columns 635C–670D. Retained column locators make the cited 635C–D passage independently reopenable. Acquired page names Corpus Corporum as its source. No printed-column collation claimed; only the preface and immediate context were inspected for the adopted reception boundary.
artifacts.rights_basis: Rabanus’s ninth-century Latin and the nineteenth-century Migne printing are public domain in the United States. Retained derivative contains their Latin text and source-column locators only, excluding Wikisource navigation, templates, modern title/encoding notices, export links and licensing wrapper; no rights in modern wiki markup are claimed.

edition.publication: J.-P. Migne, Patrologia Latina 109, columns 635C–670D; Latin Wikisource via Corpus Corporum, retrieved 12 October 2026
edition.title: Expositio in librum Esther, PL 109, Wikisource transcription

work.author: Rabanus Maurus
work.description: Allegorical exposition of Esther, with dedicatory preface addressed to Queen Judith; PL 109, columns 635C–670D. The preface explicitly excludes exposition of the Greek additions.
work.title: Expositio in librum Esther
